Name: [Project] Variance measures must show their sign
Description: finance-variance: a money or % variance needs an explicit negative section in its format string ((\$#,0) or +0.0%;-0.0%), so an overrun never reads as a beat. Ranks, bars, colours, flags and shares are not variances.
Expression: RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)variance") and not RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)rank|bar|color|status|arrow|share|p95|outlier") and not FormatString.Contains(";")
